thread:
maria: heads-up: starting deploy for feature/response-caching in 10m. planning to toggle ff 'response_cache_v2' to 5% and monitor.
kevin: noted. can we run it in safe-mode — fallback to response_cache_v1 and enable deadman's switch? want quick kill if errors.
maria: yes. i'll start with 5% and a controlled pause after canary. will also pin the runtime lib to avoid incompat issues.
deploy-bot: deploy job jb-65432 started by maria. initiating canary slice -> 5% across CANARY hosts.
deploy-bot: healthchecks ok so far: p95 +2ms, error-rate 0.02%, throughput nominal.
jon: quick Q — what's the auto-rollback threshold for this flag? if proxy errors spike we need auto-fail.
sre-oncall: current auto-rollback = 0.5% errors over 5m. alerting rule 'ff_auto_rollback' posts to #incidents.
maria: i'm going to add a stricter manual guard: i'll pause if error >0.2% for 1m and call SRE.
kevin: i'll pin routing-lib to 1.4.1 during rollout to avoid the 1.4.2 regressions we saw in staging.
maria: pinned runtime image to redwood/runtime:1.4.1 in the deployment manifest.
deploy-bot: canary progress: 5% -> 10% -> 12% (controlled pause).
deploy-bot: pause reason: elevated 503 rate from edge-proxy cluster x3, observed at 12:34:22 UTC.
jon: logs show repeated upstream resets, sample: ```
503 GET /v1/infer -> upstream reset
at proxy/router.go:142
```
sre-oncall: confirming spike across proxy-a and proxy-b. initiating immediate rollback to 0% for response_cache_v2.
sre-oncall: command: /ops/ff_toggle --name=response_cache_v2 --pct=0 --reason="upstream 503 spike"
deploy-bot: feature flag update accepted. response_cache_v2 => 0% (23s). traffic drained to stable path.
maria: thanks. can everyone hold on further deploys until we validate pinned runtime and proxy fix?
kevin: adding this to release notes draft: "response_cache_v2 rollout paused due to upstream 503; pinned runtime to 1.4.1; auto-rollback executed." will push to the release channel.
jon: suggested follow-up: create a lightweight "safe-mode" flag that routes 10% to fallback service and keeps main path at 90% for quick toggles.
sre-oncall: created INF-1423 for proxy investigation and feature-flag strategy followups. assigned to network oncall.
sre-oncall: also lowered the auto-rollback threshold for routing-related flags to 0.3% for the next week as a temporary guard.
deploy-bot: deploy job jb-65432 status -> ROLLBACK_COMPLETE. job marked FAILED.
maria: acknowledged. i'll re-run the preflight tests against the pinned runtime and schedule retry in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tomorrow.
kevin: ack. i'll update the change window notes and include the manual pause checklist. :thumbsup:
jon: +1 to safer gating and a quickplaybook for manual kills.
maria: thanks all — great reflexes on the rollback. will follow up with postmortem items after INF-1423 updates."
